first.rationale: I intend to test a targeted onboarding simplification because onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding improves time-to-value and early adoption. Verifying the onboarding and activation records will clarify whether the observed gains were durable and whether simplification risks reducing downstream qualified usage. This is preferable to promotional pricing because the pricing evidence has a cohort-definition caveat and may improve acquisition without maximizing sustainable qualified revenue.
